title: Homology and carrier faces of simplicial distributions
summary: We study the facial structure of simplicial distribution polytopes using topological and algebraic methods. In the theory of simplicial distributions, measurement and event spaces are represented by simplicial sets, and compatible probability assignments form a convex polytope. Given a simplicial distribution, it is known that its supports determine its carrier face. Moreover, the supports form a simplicial subset of the event space.
